about_the_game:
Game Introduction

"Dingfengbo · Ningzhou" is a passionate love AVG game set in a fantasy and alternate world. The game features multiple endings and several playable characters. Players will take on the roles of the male protagonist Zhou Zhi, who was demoted to a mining slave, and his sister Zhou LAN, who depend on each other for survival. They will struggle to survive under the man-eating rule of elimination at the end, gradually growing from an unknown mining slave into a hero

Tian Shou, Wan Quan Hall, Asura Department, Ling Shan... The stormy Ningzhou is full of uncertainties. Even more terrifying secrets lurk in the abyss. When this land calls out to a hero with a hoarse blood throat, he just opens his eyes from the nightmare...

Game background

After the destruction of Miaoxiang Kingdom

The Tian Shou Dynasty established prefectures under its jurisdiction

No. "Ningzhou"

The Galan ink here is abundant in spiritual power and of extraordinary value

Tianshou's demand for gamma ink is increasing day by day

Zhou Zhi, who was demoted to be a mining slave, and his sister Zhou LAN relied on each other for survival

The already hard life is becoming increasingly unsustainable

The cannibalistic rule of elimination at the end

Forcing the public to know has to be done in another way

If you don't want to be eaten

It can only eat people...

I just want to ask for a piece of information about a way out

Constantly being drawn into increasingly deep conspiracies

Capital City, Wanquan Hall, Asura Tribe, Ling Mountain...

Ningzhou, in a state of turmoil and turmoil, is shrouded in mysterious and unpredictable waves

A more terrifying secret is peeping into the abyss

When this land calls for a hero with a hoarse blood throat

He just opened his eyes from a nightmare...

The river head is not full of bad weather

There is no such thing as a difficult journey in this world

Who can?

Ding Fengbo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: 《定风波·宁州》是一款奇幻架空背景下的热血恋爱AVG游戏，游戏内包含多种结局和多个可攻略角色，玩家将扮演男主角周知，从一个寂寂无名的矿奴逐渐成长为一个英雄，和多个充满魅力的角色一起创造特别的回忆，改变宁州将面临的可怕命运
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
